subject.title: feat(skills): declarative cron-trigger metadata in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should SKILL.md metadata be allowed to declare autonomous scheduled/event execution, and if so under which approval, provenance, and revocation boundary?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but accepting the proposed field would create a public skill metadata and autonomous execution contract that affects operator trust and security policy.

options.title: Design gated core contract first
options.body: Define approved metadata shape, operator consent, ClawHub/provenance handling, revocation, and audit semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep cron explicit
options.body: Reject automatic skill-owned scheduling for now and document explicit cron jobs or a non-functional trigger_description field as the supported path.

options.title: Defer to plugin/ClawHub RFC
options.body: Move the direction into a broader skill trust or plugin API design discussion before adding any runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Design gated core contract first
recommendation.body: Define approved metadata shape, operator consent, ClawHub/provenance handling, revocation, and audit semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history put steipete closest to the skill metadata/prompt paths and adjacent security/product policy surfaces.
